controls.note: M3 has one size per component and a numeric density scale. MDC formula: map.get($property-scale-map, default) + $density-scale * $interval; interval 4px; button 36px → min 24px; text field 56px → min 40px (52px while a filled label is shown). density-N rows come from Angular Material's M3 tables.

structure.note: Reference tonal palettes (tone 0–100) → system colour roles by fixed tone per mode (e.g. primary = primary40 in light, primary80 in dark).

algorithm.name: Material dynamic colour (HCT tonal palettes + DynamicScheme)
inputs: scheme variant (tonal spot, neutral, vibrant, expressive, fidelity, content, monochrome, rainbow, fruit salad)
outputs: six tonal palettes: primary, secondary, tertiary, neutral, neutral-variant, error
49 colour roles, each a tone of one palette
algorithm.description: The source colour is converted to HCT (CAM16 hue and chroma, L* tone). Each palette keeps a hue and chroma chosen by the variant and varies only tone; roles pick tones, adjusted so that role pairs meet contrast targets at the requested contrast level.

findings: The token set has exactly two typeface slots, brand and plain, both Roboto; no per-script or per-language typeface, line-height or tracking token exists. Body, label and title-medium/small steps carry non-zero Latin tracking (letter-spacing), which Arabic must not inherit.

Direction-aware tokens are limited to logical naming: shape corner-large-start / corner-large-end and component leading-space / trailing-space. @material/web resolves them with :dir()/[dir=rtl] selectors in component styles.

Density is not a token in @material/web (the only mention is a deprecated data-table token file). The −1…−3 scale is implemented per component: MDC computes default + scale × 4px clamped to a per-component minimum; Angular Material ships explicit M3 tables.
Touch target: components keep a 48px touch wrapper around smaller visuals (literal 48px in chips/fab styles); Angular Material disables it at density −2 and below.

gaps: No spacing scale, breakpoint, container or z-index tokens in the published token set (M3 window size classes are documentation only).
No border-width scale (outline widths are per component).
Density is not tokenised in @material/web; density rows are from Angular Material, a separate Google implementation of M3.
